svg.title: Three Copilot Licence Models
svg.desc: Three Copilot licence models: Copilot Chat included with Microsoft 365 for everyone, the monthly per-user Microsoft 365 Copilot licence for daily in-app users, and pay-as-you-go for occasional agent use billed through Azure.
svg.text: Segment users by need, then match each segment to a model.
Daily users of own data in apps
